title: The Essays of Arthur Schopenhauer; Studies in Pessimism

Schopenhauer illustrates human existence as a series of disappointments, marked by an underlying madness due to unfulfilled desires. Through vivid analogies about life's futility and the inevitability of death, he positions existence as fundamentally flawed.
